messages:
Hannah L: Quick question / converting contractor Jules K to a 0.6 FTE perm role. Proposed FTE salary $145,000 -> prorated $87,000 (60%). Our S4 cap at 60% is $83,500, so we're about $3.5k over. Preferred start 2026-10-05, fallback 2026-10-19. Who needs to sign off and what's the quickest path?

Raj S: Candidate verbally accepted. No relocation. Role IC3. Manager justification ready. Candidate prefers base only, no equity.

Priya - People Ops: Routing checklist: 1) manager justification + org head signoff; 2) finance to confirm prorate & budget; 3) comp committee for >$2k prorate variance; 4) legal for contractor->employee conversion; 5) benefits for part-time eligibility. If you paste the manager justification I'll open HR ticket. Also confirm org code and last contractor invoice date.

Hannah L: Manager justification: "Jules leads the SDK infra transition and is the only person with prior system access; conversion avoids repeated ramp and reduces 3rd-party spend. Team budget covers 0.6 FTE." Org code ENG-SDK. Last contractor invoice planned 2026-09-30.

Marta (Comp Lead): We'll put this on the comp committee agenda. At ~3.5k prorate variance committee usually considers either a small base exception or a one-time cash top-up. Which does candidate prefer?

Raj S: Candidate prefers base uplift, equity not acceptable. They can accept later start if needed.

Finance Bot: Please include chargeback center and confirm budget line. If committee approves base exception we'll need annualized impact and VP People awareness if annualized >$4k.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks  opening HR ticket HR-3077777777 and routing to finance@, comp-committee@, legal@, benefits@. Reply with `+approve` or `-need info`. Payroll cutoff for 2026-10-05 start is 2026-09-20; if we miss approvals, earliest active payroll will be 2026-11-01.

Marta (Comp Lead): +approve to place on agenda (not final). Please attach benchmarking and manager justification in the ticket. We'll vote on Fri.

Hannah L: Attached benchmarking in ticket and confirmed org chargeback ENG-SDK-01. Will update candidate about potential payroll windows.

Priya - People Ops: Great :thumbsup: I'll post committee outcome here once decided.
